newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria expected to free detained Briton.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria expected to free detained Briton.

text.p: A Briton detained in Nigeria without charge since December 22 is expected to be freed soon, a British embassy spokesman said on Friday.

Bruce Henderson, 42 was detained while travelling in the politically sensitive Bakassi peninsula in the southeast where troops from Nigeria and Cameroon have frequently clashed over their rival territorial claims to the oil-rich area.
"We have indications that we might be able to bring his detention to an end sooner rather than later," the embassy spokesman said, adding "We are very optimistic."
Henderson, from Aberdeenshire, was working on a rain forest project in Cameroon.
"No reason was given for his detention which was brought to our attention on January 8," the embassy spokesman said.
But he said Henderson was safe and well and was now being held in Lagos.

Military-ruled Nigeria is shunned internationally for alleged human rights violations involving the detention of many opposition figures, including Moshood Abiola, the presumed winner of an annulled 1993 presidential election.
